data.name: Danette
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Danai, meaning 'Danaos' daughter. In Greek mythology, Danai was a legendary woman who was given 50 daughters by Zeus. 'Danette' is a modern variation of this ancient name, and it carries the beautiful meaning of 'God's gift'.
